summary: Phase 135R independently re-derived and verified Phase 135Q's Stage 2 ("Atomic Publication Rehearsal, Legacy Authority") contract in docs/PHASE_135_ATOMIC_PUBLICATION_REHEARSAL_CONTRACT_VERIFICATION.md. This is a documentation-only independent-verification phase -- no Stage 2 implementation, no rehearsal generation, no rehearsal pointer, no production pointer change, no authority cutover, and no legacy-authority demotion or retirement occurred. Verification proceeded by reading 135Q's full 1,174-line document directly, cross-checking every section-number citation against the real headers of CLTR-001 (33 sections) and CLTR-SCHEMA-001 v1.0.1 (30 sections), and independently re-grepping current source (src/pcae/core/finalization_transaction.py, src/pcae/cltr/migration/*.py) for every load-bearing factual claim in 135Q's finding dispositions and entry-point table, rather than trusting 135Q's own prose. Independently re-confirmed F-135P-1 through F-135P-4's accuracy against live source: the two-key _ENTRY_POINT_RECOVERY_CLASSIFICATION dict, the sole phase_commit_ownership=() call site (confirmed LEGACY_COMPLETION_FIELDS never re-populates it), the unreachable EXPECTED_REPRESENTATION_DIFFERENCE/TEMPORAL_ORDER_MISMATCH comparison-result classes (declared in enums.py, not comparison.py as both 135P and 135Q state -- a pre-existing, non-Stage-2-relevant location imprecision), and the NON_AUTHORITY_DISCLOSURE hardcoding. Verified all 55 required verification areas: Stage 2 definition, authority matrix, rehearsal-generation identity, namespace isolation, candidate-artifact inventory and role taxonomy, all seven per-candidate contracts, external-effect separation, manifest and generation-digest contracts, the 19-step candidate-assembly sequence, preconditions, mismatch policy, pointer contract, atomicity claim, filesystem assumptions, the 16-row crash matrix, the 11-state recovery matrix, idempotency, conflicting replay, quarantine, rehearsal comparison, progression eligibility, the Stage 2 evidence record, read-only command contracts, rollback rehearsal and roll-forward preference, split-brain analysis, four-entry-point verification (independently re-confirmed all four exact call sites and line numbers), ordinary/recovery-path verification, the 135H.1 escape-resistance proof (independently re-traced the nine-step gate chain), exactly-once preservation, notification/marker/receipt isolation, feature configuration, the invalid-configuration matrix, security and containment, the no-execution boundary, the planned package/test/fault-injection plans, acceptance criteria, inherited-finding dispositions, the risk register, the cross-reference matrix (spot-checked against real CLTR-001/CLTR-SCHEMA-001/135M section content), internal consistency, and implementation readiness. Recorded four Non-Blocking findings (F-135R-1 through F-135R-4): a citation defect (135Q cites a nonexistent persistence.py:137-233 range for the atomic-rename precedent; the file is 140 lines; corrected to the real file-level precedent at lines 84-112, with a disclosed caveat that directory-level generation-finalization rename is a new, unprecedented though still POSIX-atomic primitive, distinct from Stage 1's file-level precedent, carrying its own Windows-transient-PermissionError caveat); an undercounted NON_AUTHORITY_DISCLOSURE hardcoding count (7 occurrences repo-wide, not 5 -- the 2 extra copies live in the out-of-scope Stage 0 shadow namespace, src/pcae/cltr/persistence.py and src/pcae/cltr/inspection.py); a missing risk-register row for the citation defect; and a disclosed, not-separately-repaired split-brain completeness note (a concurrent rollback-vs-ordinary-publication pointer race is covered by the underlying atomic-replace mechanism but is not named as its own split-brain row or its own test module). Zero Blocking findings survive independent re-derivation: none of the four findings creates authority ambiguity, weakens split-brain prevention, leaves recovery incomplete, introduces unsafe pointer semantics, or creates exactly-once uncertainty. Three findings were repaired documentation-only, entirely within the new 135R document; 135Q's frozen contract document was not edited; no source or test file was modified. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. No production source file under src/ was modified. No production test file was modified. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. CLTR-001, CLTR-SCHEMA-001 v1.0.1, PFN-001, PFR-001, and the 135M/135N migration contract all unchanged. Recommends 135S -- Atomic Publication Rehearsal Implementation next (must resolve F-135P-1, F-135P-3, F-135P-4, and the EXPECTED_REPRESENTATION_DIFFERENCE half of F-135P-2 before the Stage 2 rehearsal flag is enabled beyond isolated testing; must remain legacy-authoritative and rehearsal-only).
